title: “HAckXpo-2k21”
content:
“HAckXpo-2k21”

ATME College of Engineering is celebrating its decennial year, on account of this Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering is organizing One day state level “HAckXpo-2k21”.

Benefits of Virtual Hackathon:  This online event has many benefits, some of them are:

  1. Cost: Traditional hackathon can cost more due to the factor of meal costs for the attendees, space utilities, etc,.
  2. Environment: Working from home means that every attendee gets to customize the conditions and create an optimal work environment.
  3. Training: Attendees need to delegate, communicate, demonstrate and compromise all from behind a computer screen. Developing and Mastering these building skills will serve attendees long beyond the event’s end.
 

Date: 20st July 2021

Time: 10.00 AM to 4.O0 PM

Who can enroll? : Final year students.

Meeting Platform: Microsoft Teams
